I'll help you warm up by exploring the codebase structure and understanding what files are available in this Claude Code Sync extension project.

Let me start by examining the overall directory structure:
```bash
ls -la
```

And check what's in the main files:
```bash
ls -la package.json
```

Let me also look for any source code directories and configuration files:
```bash
find . -type f -name "*.js" -o -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.json" -o -name "*.md" -o -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" | head -20
```
